scope: Source-only durable PTY geometry, native SIGWINCH and version-2 input-head cutover after public SDK/runtime 0.12.1

before.evidence: Pinned base source: Action had no terminal control operation, native get_size returned fixed 80/24, and the input feeder returned after delivered EOF
before.limit: This is a source comparison, not a recorded pre-change failing runtime test

resize.revision: Observed unsigned-32-bit revision, required; stale state and concurrent input mutation return 409
resize.noOp: Same size with current revision preserves R2 ETag and emits no signal
resize.lifecycle: Queued/running PTYs only; stdin EOF alone does not prevent resizing; settled receipts return 409

contract.authority: Existing sandbox capabilities, lifetime and expiry checks; read-only access cannot repair an incompletely initialized input head
contract.acknowledgement: Retained desired state, not synchronous guest observation; existing adaptive polling observes updates cooperatively

ownership.persisted: InputHead version 2 in the existing process-input/<sandbox>/<id>.json owns terminal geometry alongside size/chunks/EOF; null geometry for pipe input
ownership.publication: Existing input-head ETag serializes resize, append and close; no second terminal namespace, coordinator, application database or extra production Worker
ownership.native: Terminal Cell values own applied geometry/revision within its process-family heap; get_size reads those cells for each actual descriptor
ownership.signal: Existing native process signal policy is shared by proc_kill and resize; a newly applied revision queues SIGWINCH to the terminal foreground group, initially the root group
ownership.coalescing: Every higher retained revision signals, including updates that return to the old dimensions; repeated observations of the same applied revision do not duplicate signals
ownership.reader: Geometry is read with the existing input head even at capacity or after EOF; only actual input, closure or geometry progress notifies/reset backoff
ownership.initialization: Geometry is installed before fresh entry and before parked guest resumption

nativeProofs.runtime: Native Alchemy workerd, R2 and Queue; actual platform-proxy service binding and compiled Rust guest programs; no replacement bindings or execution mocks

focused.command: bun test tests/terminal-resize.test.ts tests/input-migration.test.ts tests/pty-recovery.test.ts tests/published-pty.test.ts

bindingAndGuest: Scoped Effect makeBinding sends actual terminal calls through a native Service.local binding
Read-only terminal status succeeds; resize fails 403
Malformed zero-width request returns 400 without changing the head ETag
Two same-revision resize requests produce one success and one 409
After stdin EOF, two SIGWINCH handlers read expected dimensions from native fd 0/1/2 and interrupt real clock polls
No-op resize preserves ETag and signal count
A separate TypeScript guest calls terminal.status and terminal.resize through scoped tools; returned revision and target guest exit/output are checked
replacement: Read-only status does not create a missing input head; execute-authorized recovery recreates it from the archived reservation
Concurrent input close and resize preserve both fields; any 409 is followed by native status inspection before an explicit retry
132-by-45 geometry survives replacing the Worker and is visible in the first guest instruction
Raw-mode active checkpoint restores a retained 132-by-45 resize with exact buffered bytes and EOF
Two parked resizes returning to 80-by-24 coalesce to one SIGWINCH at retained revision 2
Caught signal interrupts a non-restarting host_tty.read without losing its frame
With SA_RESTART, the parked host_tty.read resumes and receives the retained hel bytes after EOF
Duplicate stale Queue deliveries preserve terminal receipt ETag and byte output
nativeProofs.publishedShell: Digest-pinned Brush Reedline runs interactive commands, history and line editing after a 120-by-40 resize; fixed cursor replies are used rather than rendered-screen assertions

migration.deployment: Unconditional Alchemy action after process receipt migration, with typed input/receipt and continuation loop; no flags or manual pause gate
migration.bounds: 50 input heads per page; four concurrent native operations; input bodies limited to 131072 bytes and process receipts to 8388608 bytes
migration.conversion: Version 1 preserves size, chunks and EOF; existing PTY receipt gets previous fixed 80/24/revision-0 geometry, other/orphan input gets null; conditional ETag publication
migration.runtime: Version 2 only; historical version decoding is confined to the migration owner
proof: 56 historical heads span two pages; replaying the first page converts zero already-current records
Native stdout/input block references and byte counts remain unchanged
Already resized version-2 geometry and ETag survive full migration replay
Scoped capability cannot call administrator migration endpoint
Inconsistent historical chunk total returns 500 without rewriting the bad head; after correcting fixture data, replay converts only that head
migration.heapLimit: Does not convert older Rust heap layouts; exact-runtime digest validation remains enforced

benchmark.limit: Unpaired general native workloads, not a terminal latency, idle-control request-count or production billing comparison; existing performance-local.json bytes restored after the run

delivery.publication: No new release or public asset upload
delivery.deployment: No new deployment or production migration
delivery.minutei: Consumer unchanged; no Minutei push or deploy
